name: agenda-mm
description: Sistema de Agenda, Notas Adhesivas y API Flask con Flutter APK

scripts.android:dev: powershell -Command "$m = ((adb devices -l | Select-String 'transport_id:(\d+)').Matches | Select-Object -First 1).Groups[1].Value; if ($m) { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run -d (adb -t $m get-serialno) } else { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run }"
scripts.android:release: powershell -Command "$m = ((adb devices -l | Select-String 'transport_id:(\d+)').Matches | Select-Object -First 1).Groups[1].Value; if ($m) { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run --release -d (adb -t $m get-serialno) } else { Set-Location agenda_app; flutter run --release }"
scripts.android:install: powershell -Command "$m = ((adb devices -l | Select-String 'transport_id:(\d+)').Matches | Select-Object -First 1).Groups[1].Value; if ($m) { adb -t $m install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk; adb -t $m shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity } else { adb install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk; adb shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity }"
scripts.android:install-release: powershell -Command "$m = ((adb devices -l | Select-String 'transport_id:(\d+)').Matches | Select-Object -First 1).Groups[1].Value; if ($m) { adb -t $m install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; adb -t $m shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity } else { adb install --user 0 -r agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; adb shell am start -n com.alex.agendamm.agenda_app/.MainActivity }"
scripts.android:release-apk: cmd /c "cd agenda_app && flutter build apk --release" && powershell -Command "Copy-Item agenda_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk backend/static/apk/agenda-latest.apk -Force"
scripts.backend:db:migrate: uv run flask --app backend.app db migrate --directory backend/migrations
scripts.backend:db:upgrade: uv run flask --app backend.app db upgrade --directory backend/migrations
